Author: Kuldeep Mathur Bench: Kuldeep Mathur

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous II Bail Application No. 8988/2023 Devilal S/o Shri Rakama, Aged About 25 Years, Laalkhedi, P.s.
Pratapgarh, Dist. Pratapgarh.
 (Presently Lodged In Dist. Jail, Pratapgarh).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through P.P.
 ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Chandra Purohit.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukhtiyar Khan, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 21/07/2023

This second application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.7/2023, registered at Police Station Salamgarh, District Pratapgarh, for offences under Sections 450 and 376 IPC.
The first bail application of the petitioner was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 02.05.2023.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that statements of the prosecutrix 'Mst.G' have been recorded before the competent criminal court.

Learned counsel submitted that from perusal of the statements of prosecutrix 'Mst.G' recorded before the competent criminal court, it is evident that she has denied the allegations of she being subjected to sexual assault / rape by the present petitioner.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that in view of the fact that the prosecutrix in her statements recorded before the competent criminal court has clearly denied the allegation of sexual (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8988/2023] assault / rape against the present petitioner, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
The petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

However, he was not in a position to Devilal vs State Of Rajasthan on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170780944/
1 refute the fact that the prosecutrix in her statements before the competent criminal court has denied the allegation of sexual assault / rape against the present petitioner.

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/ demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Devilal S/o Shri Rakama arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.7/2023,
registered at Police Station Salamgarh, District Pratapgarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 2-Prashant/-
